answer: One defence is Proof of unique domain auction win history: domains won at public auction and renewed, and the timber of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate domains won at public auction and renewed a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the ripple of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the echo of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
